Name: Joel, Son of Izrahiah
Summary: Son of Izrahiah, a chief man in Issachar's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:3: Son of Izrahiah, a chief man in Issachar's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Joel stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
